name: RPC & Message Protocols
purpose: Design, version, and verify RPC and message protocols with IDLs: Protobuf proto3 modeling, Cap'n Proto schemas, buf breaking-change gates, gRPC error/deadline semantics, streaming patterns, and wire-compatibility proof.
inputs: Service inventory with methods, message types, and deployed client versions
IDL toolchain pins: buf, protoc, grpcurl, capnp versions
Compatibility budget: forbidden changes, payload ceiling, p99 latency target
Error taxonomy mapping business failures to gRPC status codes with retryability
outputs: Versioned IDL package with generated stubs and migration notes
Documented error taxonomy with retryability labels per method
Compatibility and performance evidence clearing the merge gate
stop_conditions: Zero breaking findings with p99 under 120 ms at 500 RPS on the golden method set
v1 clients replay cleanly against v2 servers with old fields decoding correctly
